data.title: Al Serh Residences
data.about:
Al Serh Residences 11 by Serh Al Asak Real Estate is a modern development located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), offering a total of 105 well-designed units. The project includes a mix of studio, 1 and 2 bedroom apartments available with a 24 months post-handover payment plan. 

Each unit boasts large balconies and eco-friendly features, creating a visually appealing and sustainable living environment. High-end finishes and ample parking spaces enhance the experience for both residents and visitors, while retail spaces on-site add to the convenience of living in this vibrant community.

characteristics_module.title: Experience the Ultimate Family Lifestyle at Al Serh Residences 11 in JVC!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location:Situated in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Al Serh Residences 11 Dubai offers excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai.
  • Diverse Unit Options: A mix of studios, one-bedroom, one-bedroom plus, and two-bedroom apartments, catering to various preferences and needs.
  • Comprehensive Amenities: Offers a lap pool, Zen garden, kids’ play area, BBQ spaces, gym, sauna, and resident lounges for a complete lifestyle experience.
  • Retail Convenience: On-site retail spaces add to the convenience for residents and visitors.
  • Ample Parking: Dedicated parking spaces ensure ease of access for both residents and guests.
  • Fully Furnished: Ready-to-move-in homes tailored for contemporary lifestyles.
  • Handover by May 2025: An ideal timeline for your next investment, offering early ROI or the perfect dream home.
  • Flexible Payment Options: Benefit from a 24-month post-handover payment plan.

location_tile.title: An Exciting New Residential Development in JVC!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Al Serh Residences 11 is situated in the dynamic and ever-growing Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) community, a neighborhood known for its harmonious blend of modern urban living and family-friendly amenities. JVC offers a diverse mix of residential properties, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, catering to individuals and families alike. The area is thoughtfully designed with lush green spaces, parks, and walking trails, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. 

  • 02 Minutes: JSS International School
  • 05 Minutes: Circle Mall
  • 07 Minutes: Aster Clinic
  • 10 Minutes: Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 12 Minutes: City Centre Me’aisem
  • 15 Minutes: Dubai Hills Mall
  • 16 Minutes: Dubai Autodrome
